Build is green.

I implemented the disposable-domain blocklist as a small, self-contained addition following the existing `Reject*` pattern, keeping structural impact minimal — no existing function was modified:

- **`RejectDisposableEmailDomain`** — a new single-method function class (WMC_other = 0) that reads the already-normalized email `@Val` and throws when the domain is one of `mailinator.com`, `tempmail.com`, `guerrillamail.com`.
- **`DisposableEmailDomainException`** — new checked exception.
- **`DisposableEmailDomainExceptionHandler`** + its escalation YAML — responds 400, mirroring `InvalidPostcodeException`.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted a `rejectDisposableEmail` step after `normalizeEmail` (which lower-cases/syntax-checks the email first), so the only edit to an existing file is one `next:` retarget plus the new step block.

The acceptance test `errorRejectsDisposableDomain` and the full suite pass (BUILD SUCCESS).
